from pathlib import Path
p=Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1790689824/attempts/9d615e3a66d9447e8803eb583e82b2e3/system/state/workspace/programs/task-ec36cea4.py')
p.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
code='''def transform(grid):
    # Each isolated non-background horizontal run becomes one output cell.
    background = max(set(v for row in grid for v in row), key=lambda c: sum(row.count(c) for row in grid))
    counts = {}
    for row in grid:
        prev = background
        for value in row:
            if value != background and value != prev:
                counts[value] = counts.get(value, 0) + 1
            prev = value
    cells = []
    for color in sorted(counts, reverse=True):
        cells.extend([color] * counts[color])
    cells = (cells + [background] * 6)[:6]
    return [cells[:3], cells[3:]]
'''
p.write_text(code)
exec(compile(code,str(p),'exec'), globals())
